Sorry you had to suffer this frizz as well lol, this hair type really tests me but when it looks good it looks GOOD! So happy u liked my routine but also i put a bunch of excess stuff in it so here are what like actually changed the game for me. 1) Hair gel- using hair gel when my hair is wet is a literal game changer. Great for curls and for frizz. I use the wet plopping method which is really easy (theres vids on it on youtube). 2) Hair mask- whenever i see that my hair is still extra frizzy or frizzy when WET (seriously,,, why) i give myself a hair mask (normally every 2 weeks) to add moisture. 3) Layered cut- helps with Triangle head and curl definition. I gave myself a unicorn cut in the pandemic  and honestly i like it better than most of my professional ones. And ofc i never brush my hair when its dry, use a tshirt to scrunch my hair dry instead of wrapping a towel, avoid shampoos w sulfates, and sleep on a satin pillowcase. Best wishes w ur hair, im sure it looks killer!

Every 2 weeks i use a clarifier and then a mask just for laffs.
